name: shader-video-player
description: Desktop video player with real-time shader effects (CRT, VHS)

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/check-ffmpeg.mjs && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:dev-gpl: npm run build && node scripts/check-ffmpeg.mjs --dev-gpl --host-only && electron-builder --mac --dir

author: Alec Reimel
